Title: Scenarios Expanded
Author: Steve
Description:
Two start scenarios for Terra Invicta, each built on the world as it actually stood on the day it begins.

- 1899 - War for our World: the assumed year the story of The War of the Worlds takes place. 52 sovereign states, a fully colonial map, no spaceflight, no nuclear weapons.
- 1947 - Roswell: the day Roswell Army Air Field reported recovering a flying disc. The Cold War is starting, Germany, Austria, Japan and Korea have been carved up among the victors, and only the United States has the bomb. The disc comes down over New Mexico.
- Don't ask me how it is possible that councilors can move that quick without actual planes. They just can. They fly now.
